dialect.detail: Uses GnuCOBOL-style debug lines with '+DEBUG*' indicator in column 7, DYNAMIC file assignment, ARGUMENT-NUMBER/ARGUMENT-VALUE special registers, and LINE SEQUENTIAL organization — all characteristic of GnuCOBOL
evidence: END-ADD, END-DISPLAY, END-EVALUATE, END-READ, END-PERFORM, END-IF, END-STRING

purpose.domain_detail: Implementation of the GORBITSA esoteric programming language interpreter
purpose.summary: This program implements an interpreter for the GORBITSA esoteric programming language. It loads a GORBITSA program from a file specified as a command-line argument, then executes it by iterating through instructions and dispatching on opcodes (T for Transmit, S for Set, others as NOOP). It is a toy/demo interpreter for an esoteric language.

notable_features: Conditional debug lines using +DEBUG* indicator (GnuCOBOL debug line feature)
ACCEPT FROM ARGUMENT-NUMBER / ARGUMENT-VALUE for command-line argument handling
OCCURS clause for RAM array (256 elements) and instruction array
PERFORM THRU pattern for paragraph ranges
No GOTO except GO EXIT-PROGRAM (paragraph fall-through style)
verdict.notes: The +DEBUG* lines in column 7 are GnuCOBOL debug indicator lines, activated with the -fdebugging-line compiler flag. The program implements only a subset of GORBITSA opcodes (T and S), suggesting it is incomplete or a learning exercise. No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS.
